title: Variance lower bound from Fourier degree
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $k$ be a positive integer, and let $f:\\{-1,1\\}^n\\to\\{-1,1\\}$. If the Fourier degree of its real-valued sign embedding is at most $k$ and $f$ is nonconstant, then its variance under the uniform distribution on the sign cube is at least $2^{-(k-1)}$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ maps the sign cube to the two signs
the Fourier degree of the real-valued sign embedding of $f$ is at most $k$
